issue.title: Support UUID serialization in REST Client multipart bodies
RESTEasy Reactive doesn't support `java.time.OffsetDateTime`
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

This is similar to https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/31298, but for `java.time.OffsetDateTime`.
I have a PR ready.

### Expected behavior

`OffsetDateTime` attribute should be serialized to String.

### Actual behavior

A serializer can't be found.
